[[Major/Legends|Major]] '''Orten Ledes''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Army of Light/Legends|Army of Light]] that fought during the [[New Sith Wars]]. Ledes was one of the highest ranking non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] members of the [[Second Legion of Light]]. He survived the climactic [[Seventh Battle of Ruusan]], and was sent to the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]] by [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Valenthyne Farfalla]] in order to fetch the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Johun Othone]], who had traveled to the surface against Farfalla's express orders. Ledes found Othone with two surrendered [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] from the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] and took all three back to the [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] fleet.
